capabilities: draw formulas on a pen/eraser handwriting canvas with pan, zoom, and selection tools
import images and crop, rotate, or enhance the formula region
recognize formulas via SimpleTex, custom APIs, or experimental Mathpix and OpenAI backends
insert recognized LaTeX inline, display, or raw
review past recognitions in a history of canvas snapshots
extras: SimpleTex is the recommended free backend; Mathpix and OpenAI GPT-4o Vision support and the camera capture feature are labeled experimental. Also installable via BRAT.
problem: Typing complex math in LaTeX is slow; Obsidian has no built-in way to draw formulas by hand or convert formula images to LaTeX.

relations.evidence: It supports multiple API backends, with SimpleTex as the recommended (and free) option.
viewport-based infinite canvas in the style of Tldraw/Excalidraw

requires.name: API token/key (SimpleTex UAT, Mathpix, OpenAI, or custom API)
SimpleTex account to create a UAT token

summary: Handwriting and image-to-LaTeX plugin that recognizes drawn or imported formulas via OCR APIs and inserts LaTeX into notes.
